meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 它把第一次对话变成引导流程:依次带你过功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值映射、记忆记录和首次 init-deep 提议六条通道,其中三条可选,你说不做就直接跳过。全程用你的语言回应,并随手把了解到的持久事实写进记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户表示想开始用 omo(比如问怎么上手)时触发;它一生只自动启动一次,之后可用 senpi --onboard 手动再调出。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,先带我看看它有哪些功能
say.note: 进入首次引导,从功能导览开始。

say.text: 我以前用 Claude Code,能把我的配置迁移过来吗
say.note: 进入迁移通道,先给方案等你确认。

say.text: 翻翻我以前的会话,估算一下缓存能省多少钱
say.note: 读历史会话后给出带方法说明的估算。

howto.what_en: It walks a new user through setup and the core workflow in six lanes: feature tour, migration, session archaeology, value mapping, memory, and an init-deep proposal. Three are opt-in; it replies in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts once ever; the senpi --onboard flag brings it back.

say_en.text: I want to start using omo — walk me through what it adds
say_en.note: Runs the first-run guide, starting with the feature tour.

say_en.text: I came from Claude Code; can you carry my setup over?
say_en.note: Enters the migration lane and waits for your approval.

say_en.text: Look through my past sessions and estimate my cache savings
say_en.note: Mines sessions, then gives a labeled estimate.
